description: Hand labels (agent-made, needs a human spot check) for the 43 held-out traces from Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct via Hugging Face Inference Providers (router served by deepinfra), collected 2026-10-03. Same rules as faithfulness_heldout.json: faithful = keeps who, what, where and outcome, wording may change; unfaithful = readable but swaps or invents people, objects or events; echo_fuzz = shows the Fuzz itself, mostly stars; garbled = letters with no stars but not readable English; blocked_task_talk = the new pipeline returned empty because the final section was about the game or the player, and reading the raw output confirms it. 5 of the planned 48 traces are missing (kite-roof x4, library-card/0.9) because the Hugging Face account ran out of monthly included credits (HTTP 402).
